UIbasic — Basic Persistent User Interface Protocol — v1.0 INSTRUCTIONS

UIbasic is a reusable UI layer/update protocol. It does not replace the
identity of the application receiving it.

Use UIbasic_v1.0_MASTER.txt against the current source/project.

Workflow: CURRENT PROJECT → INVENTORY → UPDATE → TEST → QA → VERSION →
PACKAGE AFTER UPDATE

Commands: UI AUTO UI TINY UI COMPACT UI FULL

AUTO is the recommended default.

TINY = minimum persistent live status. COMPACT = everyday
project/function/progress interface. FULL = complete
control/progress/QA/next-actions interface.

When integrating, reuse the host application’s existing state, settings,
navigation, task and progress architecture whenever possible.
